AOD-9604: Anti-Obesity Drug 9604: a modified fragment of human growth hormone (amino acids 176–191) with an added tyrosine. Studied in fat-metabolism and lipolysis research; in studies it did not raise IGF-1 or affect blood glucose.
ARA-290: ARA-290 (cibinetide): an 11-amino-acid peptide derived from the helix-B region of erythropoietin. Studied for tissue-protective signaling through the innate repair receptor (EPOR/CD131) in neuropathy and inflammation models.
BPC-157: Body Protection Compound-157: a stable 15-amino-acid fragment of a protective protein found in gastric juice. Widely studied in tendon, ligament, muscle, gut-lining and vascular repair models.
TB-500: TB-500: a synthetic fragment of thymosin beta-4 covering its actin-binding region (LKKTETQ). Studied in cell-migration, wound-healing, flexibility and tissue-repair research.
Cagrilintide: Cagrilintide: a long-acting amylin analogue. Studied in appetite, satiety and body-weight research, including in combination with semaglutide (CagriSema).
Cardiogen: Cardiogen: a short-chain bioregulator peptide from the Khavinson series (Ala-Glu-Asp-Arg). Studied in heart-muscle cell and cardiovascular tissue research.
Cartalax: Cartalax: a short-chain bioregulator peptide from the Khavinson series associated with cartilage and connective tissue. Studied in joint, cartilage and musculoskeletal aging research.
Cerebrolysin: Cerebrolysin: a mixture of low-molecular-weight neuropeptides and amino acids derived from porcine brain proteins. Studied in neurotrophic, neuroprotection and cognitive research models.
CJC-1295 with DAC: CJC-1295 with DAC: a 29-amino-acid GHRH analogue carrying a Drug Affinity Complex that binds albumin for a multi-day half-life. Studied in growth-hormone and IGF-1 research.
CJC-1295 without DAC: CJC-1295 without DAC (Mod GRF 1-29): a tetra-substituted GHRH (1-29) analogue with a short half-life. Studied in pulsatile growth-hormone release research, often alongside a GHRP such as ipamorelin.
DSIP: Delta Sleep-Inducing Peptide: a naturally occurring nonapeptide first isolated from rabbit brain. Studied in sleep-regulation, stress-response and circadian research.
Epithalon: Epithalon (epitalon): the tetrapeptide Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly from the Khavinson series, based on the pineal peptide epithalamin. Studied in telomerase, circadian-rhythm and aging research.
NA Epithalon Amidate: N-acetyl Epithalon amidate: Epithalon (Ala-Glu-Asp-Gly) with an acetylated N-terminus and amidated C-terminus for greater stability. Studied in telomerase, circadian-rhythm and aging research.
Follistatin 344: Follistatin 344: the 344-amino-acid isoform of follistatin, a glycoprotein that binds and neutralizes myostatin and activin. Studied in muscle-growth and muscle-wasting research.
FOXO4-DRI: FOXO4-DRI: a D-retro-inverso peptide that blocks the FOXO4–p53 interaction in senescent cells. Studied in senolytic (senescent-cell clearing) and aging research.
GHK-Cu: GHK-Cu: the copper complex of the tripeptide glycyl-L-histidyl-L-lysine, naturally present in human plasma. Studied in skin, hair-follicle, collagen-production and wound-healing research.
GHRP-2 Acetate: GHRP-2 (growth hormone releasing peptide-2): a synthetic hexapeptide ghrelin-receptor agonist. Studied in growth-hormone secretion and appetite research.
Glutathione: Glutathione: the body's principal antioxidant tripeptide (glutamate-cysteine-glycine). Studied in oxidative-stress, detoxification and cellular-protection research.
HCG: Human chorionic gonadotropin: a glycoprotein hormone produced in pregnancy that acts on the LH receptor. Studied in reproductive, endocrine and fertility research.
IGF-1 LR3: IGF-1 LR3 (Long R3 insulin-like growth factor-1): an 83-amino-acid analogue of IGF-1 with an arginine substitution and N-terminal extension that reduce binding to IGF-binding proteins, extending its activity. Studied in cell-growth and muscle research.
Ipamorelin: Ipamorelin: a pentapeptide growth-hormone secretagogue and selective ghrelin-receptor agonist that releases GH with little effect on cortisol or prolactin in studies. Studied in growth-hormone research.
Kisspeptin-10: Kisspeptin-10: the 10-amino-acid active fragment of kisspeptin, a key regulator of GnRH release. Studied in reproductive-hormone signaling and puberty/fertility research.
KPV: KPV: the tripeptide Lys-Pro-Val, the C-terminal fragment of alpha-MSH. Studied in anti-inflammatory, gut-inflammation and skin research.
LL-37: LL-37: the 37-amino-acid human cathelicidin antimicrobial peptide. Studied in innate-immunity, antimicrobial, biofilm and wound-healing research.
Melanotan II: Melanotan II: a cyclic analogue of alpha-melanocyte-stimulating hormone that activates melanocortin receptors. Studied in pigmentation (melanogenesis) and melanocortin-pathway research.
MOTS-C: MOTS-c: a 16-amino-acid mitochondrial-derived peptide encoded in mitochondrial DNA. Studied in metabolism, insulin-sensitivity and exercise-physiology research.
NAD+: NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide): the coenzyme central to cellular energy production and sirtuin signaling. Studied in cellular-energy, DNA-repair and aging research.
Oxytocin Acetate: Oxytocin: the nine-amino-acid hypothalamic peptide hormone. Studied in social-behavior, bonding, stress and endocrine research.
PE-22-28: PE-22-28: a seven-amino-acid fragment of spadin, a sortilin-derived peptide that blocks the TREK-1 potassium channel. Studied in mood and neuroplasticity research models.
Pinealon: Pinealon: the tripeptide Glu-Asp-Arg from the Khavinson bioregulator series. Studied in brain-cell protection, cognition and aging research.
PNC-27: PNC-27: a peptide joining the MDM2-binding domain of p53 to a membrane-penetrating sequence. Studied for its membrane-disrupting action on cancer cells in laboratory research.
Prostamax: Prostamax: the tetrapeptide Lys-Glu-Asp-Pro from the Khavinson bioregulator series. Studied in prostate-tissue and aging research.
PT-141: PT-141 (bremelanotide): a cyclic heptapeptide melanocortin-receptor agonist derived from Melanotan II. Studied in sexual-arousal pathway and melanocortin research.
Retatrutide: Retatrutide: a triple agonist of the GIP, GLP-1 and glucagon receptors. Studied in obesity, metabolic and liver-fat research.
Selank: Selank: the heptapeptide Thr-Lys-Pro-Arg-Pro-Gly-Pro, a synthetic analogue of the immune peptide tuftsin. Studied in anxiety, stress-resilience and cognitive research.
NA Selank Amidate: N-acetyl Selank amidate: Selank with an acetylated N-terminus and amidated C-terminus for greater stability. Studied in anxiety, stress-resilience and cognitive research.
Semaglutide: Semaglutide: a long-acting GLP-1 receptor agonist (acylated for albumin binding). Studied in appetite, glucose-regulation and body-weight research.
Semax: Semax: the heptapeptide Met-Glu-His-Phe-Pro-Gly-Pro, an analogue of ACTH(4-10) without hormonal activity. Studied in cognition, attention and neuroprotection research.
NA Semax Amidate: N-acetyl Semax amidate: Semax with an acetylated N-terminus and amidated C-terminus for greater stability. Studied in cognition, attention and neuroprotection research.
Sermorelin Acetate: Sermorelin: a 29-amino-acid analogue of growth-hormone-releasing hormone (GHRH 1-29). Studied in growth-hormone secretion and pituitary research.
SLU-PP-322: SLU-PP-332: a small-molecule estrogen-related receptor (ERR) agonist studied as an 'exercise mimetic' in endurance, muscle-fiber and metabolic research.
SS-31: SS-31 (elamipretide): a tetrapeptide that binds cardiolipin in the inner mitochondrial membrane. Studied in mitochondrial-function, muscle and heart research.
Tesamorelin: Tesamorelin: a stabilized GHRH analogue (GHRH 1-44 with a hexenoyl modification). Studied in growth-hormone and visceral-fat research.
Thymalin: Thymalin: a thymus-derived bioregulator peptide complex. Studied in immune-regulation, T-cell and aging research.
Thymosin Alpha-1: Thymosin alpha-1: a 28-amino-acid peptide naturally produced by the thymus. Studied in immune-modulation, T-cell function and infection-response research.
Tirzepatide: Tirzepatide: a dual agonist of the GIP and GLP-1 receptors. Studied in glucose-regulation, appetite and body-weight research.
VIP: VIP (vasoactive intestinal peptide): a 28-amino-acid neuropeptide. Studied in vasodilation, gut-motility, immune-regulation and circadian research.
KLOW: KLOW: the GLOW blend plus KPV — 10 mg BPC-157, 10 mg TB-500, 50 mg GHK-Cu (copper tripeptide) and 10 mg KPV (anti-inflammatory alpha-MSH fragment) in one 80 mg vial. The four peptides most studied together in tissue-repair, skin, collagen and inflammation research.
GLOW|70 mg: GLOW 70: 10 mg BPC-157, 10 mg TB-500 and 50 mg GHK-Cu (copper tripeptide) in one 70 mg vial. The three peptides most studied together in skin, collagen, wound-healing and soft-tissue repair research.
GLOW|50 mg: GLOW 50: 10 mg BPC-157, 10 mg TB-500 and 30 mg GHK-Cu (copper tripeptide) in one 50 mg vial. The three peptides most studied together in skin, collagen, wound-healing and soft-tissue repair research.
GLOW: GLOW: BPC-157, TB-500 and GHK-Cu (copper tripeptide) in one vial. The three peptides most studied together in skin, collagen, wound-healing and soft-tissue repair research.
BPC-157 + TB-500|10 mg: BPC-157 + TB-500 (the "Wolverine" blend): 5 mg BPC-157 (gastric-derived pentadecapeptide) with 5 mg TB-500 (thymosin beta-4 fragment) in one 10 mg vial. Studied together in tendon, ligament, muscle and soft-tissue repair models.
BPC-157 + TB-500|20 mg: BPC-157 + TB-500 (the "Wolverine" blend): 10 mg BPC-157 (gastric-derived pentadecapeptide) with 10 mg TB-500 (thymosin beta-4 fragment) in one 20 mg vial. Studied together in tendon, ligament, muscle and soft-tissue repair models.
BPC-157 + TB-500: BPC-157 + TB-500 (the "Wolverine" blend): BPC-157 (gastric-derived pentadecapeptide) with TB-500 (thymosin beta-4 fragment) in one vial, in equal amounts. Studied together in tendon, ligament, muscle and soft-tissue repair models.
CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin|10 mg: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin: 5 mg CJC-1295 without DAC (GHRH analogue) with 5 mg ipamorelin (selective ghrelin-receptor agonist) in one 10 mg vial. The two are studied together for their complementary effect on growth-hormone release.
CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin|20 mg: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin: 10 mg CJC-1295 without DAC (GHRH analogue) with 10 mg ipamorelin (selective ghrelin-receptor agonist) in one 20 mg vial. The two are studied together for their complementary effect on growth-hormone release.
CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin: CJC-1295 + Ipamorelin: CJC-1295 without DAC (GHRH analogue) with ipamorelin (selective ghrelin-receptor agonist) in one vial, in equal amounts. The two are studied together for their complementary effect on growth-hormone release.
Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin: Tesamorelin + Ipamorelin: 10 mg tesamorelin (stabilized GHRH analogue) with 5 mg ipamorelin (selective ghrelin-receptor agonist) in one 15 mg vial. Studied together for their complementary effect on growth-hormone release.
